instagram.caption:
The expensive shade you never wear.
The Vanity Drawers in the Primary Bathroom. To hold the grooming tools and products you actually reach for, arranged by when in the day you use them.

What done looks like:
1. Every drawer divided
2. Nothing past its open-jar window
3. Razor blades capped or in a lidded box in one corner
4. A top drawer you can read in a single look without moving anything

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success vanity drawers.
